description.value: Ucluelet Liquor Store is a privately operated retail bottle shop on Peninsula Road serving the Ucluelet community with a broad selection of boutique wines, craft beer and cider, and spirits. Part of the LCHgroup family of BC liquor stores, it actively sources products on request, making it a handy stop for touring cyclists looking to resupply for a campsite or cabin. The store links out to the Ucluelet Travel Guide, signalling engagement with the local tourism scene.
